name: The Schoolhouse
description: Each teacher at the schoolhouse leads a different class in a different room. Work out who teaches what, and where.
clues: If Bungalow goes with 95%, then Nash goes with 85%.
Between 80% and 90%, one goes with Ellis and the other with Nash.
The class in the Bungalow's grade is higher than both Carver and Ellis.
The class in the Studio's grade is between the class in the Annex and Nash.
